name: @gyq-sit/innavi-layout-validator
description: Reusable Unreal Engine layout validation and tool registration plugin

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p=require('./package.json'); const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('InNaviLayoutValidator.uplugin')); if(d.VersionName!==p.version) throw Error('Plugin/package version mismatch');"
